tasks.analysis: Glaciers are massive bodies of ice that move slowly under their own weight, carving valleys and shaping landscapes as they advance and retreat. They form where snow accumulates over time and compresses into ice. Glaciers are important indicators of climate change, as their movement and size can reflect fluctuations in temperature and precipitation. Studying glaciers helps us understand past climate conditions and predict future environmental changes.
